title: Important Notice on Binance Affiliates Spot Quarterly Evaluation (2025-02-17)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The  Binance Affiliates Spot Quarterly Evaluation  process below will end with the final period at the end of September 2025 and will no longer be implemented thereafter. Starting from 2025-10-01, a new assessment system will be implemented. For more information, you can refer to our latest announcement  here . To better serve our affiliate community, Binance Affiliates have implemented new updates to the Affiliates Spot Quarterly Evaluation review process.  The New Spot Commission Rate will be implemented on  2025-02-17,  which will be based on the affiliate’s performance during the Performance Evaluation Period and the tiering process detailed below. Performance Evaluation Period: 2025-02-17 (UTC) to 2025-05-16 (UTC) Note:  Following application of the New Spot Commission Rate, the subsequent evaluation period will commence  from 2025-07-01 (UTC)  and will continue to be reviewed on a  quarterly basis  (“Quarterly Evaluations”). New Spot Commission Rate Tiers: The Binance Affiliates Spot Quarterly Evaluation and New Spot Commission Rates will be tiered as follows: New Spot Commission Rate Tiers Spot & Margin Trading Volume Generated by All Invitees during the Evaluation Period Number of New/Active Traders Achieved During the Evaluation Period Spot (30%) Referral Commission Rate Achieve a total trading volume of $200,000  A minimum of  1 new  trader  or   5 active  traders  Spot (41%) Referral Commission Rate Achieve a total trading volume of $2,500,000  A minimum of  20 new  traders  or   100 active  traders Spot (50%) Referral Commission Rate Achieve a total trading volume of $30,000,000  A minimum of  100 new  traders  or   300 active  traders Notes: This evaluation only assesses the performance of the Affiliate's Referral Pro mode. New trader : Invitees who complete their first trade in spot or margin trading on the platform during the evaluation period.  Active trader:  Invitees who complete at least one spot or margin trade during the evaluation period. To qualify for the Binance Affiliates Spot Quarterly Evaluation, affiliates need to meet both (1) the Spot & Margin trading volume  and  (2) the number of new or active traders requirements indicated in the above table. Binance Affiliates can track their evaluation performance, which will be updated the following day by 05:00 (UTC) via: Binance Website: Visit  here  > [Spot Evaluation] Binance App: Visit  here  > [Reward] > [Spot Evaluation] Commission adjustments to the affiliate’s New Spot Commission Rate will be completed by the end of the following month after each Quarterly Evaluation. Users can submit feedback on the new evaluation standard  here . Learn more about the Binance Affiliate Program  here . Terms and Conditions: All Binance Affiliates will be assessed according to the tiering criteria mentioned above. Affiliates who do not meet the minimum requirements of the evaluation will have their spot commission rate adjusted to 20% by the end of the following month. All Binance Affiliates are subject to the  Binance Affiliate Program Standard Terms and Conditions . If Binance determines that an Affiliate has violated the terms and conditions, the Affiliate’s membership and qualification will be terminated. Binance reserves the right at any time in its sole and absolute discretion to determine and/or amend or vary these Terms and Conditions without prior notice, including but not limited to canceling, extending, terminating or suspending the evaluation process, its eligibility terms and criteria. All users shall be bound by these amendments. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-17 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-09-24 to announce the termination of the current Spot Evaluation process and to highlight that the new Evaluation process will begin from 2025-10-01 onward. On 2025-02-18, this announcement was updated to emphasize that Affiliates must meet both the requirements to be qualified, and affiliates who do not meet the minimum requirements of the evaluation will have their spot commission rate adjusted to 20% by the end of the following month.
